hints.title: Length Requirement
hints.text: The password must have at least 8 characters.

hints.title: Character Diversity Rules
hints.text: Verify the presence of at least one lowercase letter, one uppercase letter, one digit, and one special character.

hints.title: Adjacent Duplicate Constraint
hints.text: No two adjacent characters may be identical: ensure each adjacent character pair has distinct elements.

hints.title: Single-Pass Condition Check Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear pass checks all password criteria.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: No complex failure mode; simple linear validation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate checks each of the 5 criteria including the adjacent duplicate prohibition.
